content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am working with an encoder that has 2048 pulses per revolution. Is it possible to use high-speed input with [product_name]?
The answer is provided in the attached image.
Not all [product_name] base modules feature fast counter inputs. Only base modules with a DC power supply offer this capability.

Inputs: I3, I4, I5, and I6 support a maximum of 5kHz frequency. Applicable models include [product_name] 24CEo, [product_name] 24CE, [product_name] 12/24RCEo, and [product_name] 12/24RCE. Refer to the [document] for system manual and technical data. Regarding frequency: if one revolution takes longer than 0.41s, it's supported; if less, [product_name] cannot be used due to the 5kHz frequency limitation. In such cases, consider switching to a [product_name] controller if preferred.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion revolves around whether a [product_name] can process high-speed counter inputs for an encoder with 2048 pulses per revolution. Users identified that module type and power supply impact compatibility, clarified input frequency limitations, and highlighted the importance of consulting documentation to determine if the device meets application needs. Some uncertainty was noted regarding model selection and usage requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes [product_name] will handle high-speed counting for their encoder and expects advice on choosing the correct model and ensuring input frequency compatibility.
